mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_trace (trace_id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, session_id, agent_id, query_text, rewrite_text, retrieval_topk, source_docs, answer_score, hallucination_score, create_time) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{queryText}, #{rewriteText}, #{retrievalTopk}, #{sourceDocs}, #{answerScore}, #{hallucinationScore}, #{createTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT agent_id AS group_key, COUNT(1) AS total, AVG(retrieval_topk) AS avg_topk FROM rag_trace
GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT owner_user_id AS group_key, COUNT(1) AS total, AVG(retrieval_topk) AS avg_topk FROM rag_trace
GROUP BY owner_user_id ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS group_key, COUNT(1) AS total, AVG(retrieval_topk) AS avg_topk FROM rag_trace
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY group_key ASC

SELECT to_char(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS group_key, COUNT(1) AS total, AVG(retrieval_topk) AS avg_topk FROM rag_trace
GROUP BY to_char(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY group_key ASC
